title: HELIX Bridge: PeopleSoft CS → StudentGroup

source_tables.description: Student group assignment. Links students to institutional group codes with effective dates.
Student group definition. Code and description for each group.

attribute_mappings.source: Derived from group code pattern or institution mapping

notes: Student groups are institution-defined cohorts used for communication, reporting, and analysis. Common uses: athletics eligibility, honors program membership, learning communities, TRiO/SSS participants, first-generation cohorts, veteran cohorts, Greek life, residential communities. Groups are a primary segmentation tool for student success initiatives.
